delta: Following the trip of the trunk corridor from Norte Chico to the Central Zone, the operator must choose between substantial operational cost savings with conservative line loading or deeper emissions abatement through southern hydroelectric redispatch.

diagnosis_es: Outage on the trunk corridor from Norte Chico to the Central Zone threatens regional energy transfer without causing unserved demand. No available operating move improves the residential shortfall under the current grid constraints.

options.title_es: Storage activation with emergency corridor rating
options.rationale_es: This option minimizes operating expenditures and line loading while securing the central corridor through storage and dynamic ratings.

options.title_es: Storage dispatch with southern hydro release
options.rationale_es: This alternative maximizes decarbonization and curtails renewable energy less by dispatching flexible southern hydro reserves.
